title: Cesar G NDE 13135
content: When I was 23 years of age, I opted for minor surgery, which required general anesthesia. The doctors decided to use an anesthetic called 'Halothane,' which is gas that goes into your nose. I remember counting from 10 to 1 and then going asleep. All of the sudden, I was floating in the room. I saw how the doctors and nurses were rushing around my body and trying to resuscitate me. At that point, I did not realize that I was dead. I rapidly found out that I was pure energy as I started traveling to several places simultaneously. I was able to visit my parents, my brother, and go wherever I wanted to go. It was amazing to be able to be in multiple times - at the same time. I was able to understand how the Universe works. I could understand the complexity and simplicity of how everything is connected. I understood the laws of physics, and how I was part of that network of energy. The feeling of freedom and peace was overwhelming. The sense of being a thought and travelling at the speed of light to all parts of the universe was fascinating to me. Then, I felt pulled to a tunnel made of pure light. The more time spent looking at that light on that tunnel, the bigger the light became. At one point, I was inside of a beautiful, white space with like clouds on the background. I started feeling the presence of a powerful being. I did not see or hear it. I just knew that I was in the presence of pure love, comprehension, and empathy towards me. It felt like when your mom hugs you unconditionally. It was pure joy, pure love, and pure understanding. There was no judgment towards me. We started a telepathic conversation that wasn't in any language. The conversation took place between two entities of energy, that understood each other. It was projected inside of me, all my existence/experiences to that point in my life; like the important moments and/or decisions that I made as a human. I realized that although I was a good kid, I was living a life without purpose and without doing anything significant for others. The Supreme energy asked me if I was happy with my life. I answered that I did the best I could based on what I knew. I wanted to stay in that place close to him/her from now on. The supreme energy told me that time and space does not exist for him, that he/she could wait for me if I needed more time. At that point, I started to think on what my legacy on earth would be if I never return to earth. I remember that I wanted to finish my studies, that I wanted to have a family with four kids. My deepest desire was to assist others on planet Earth, and that my mission was not finish yet. Then, God said, 'Then, it looks like you need to return. It is your decision to either stay here, go back in your body or go back in different body. But you have to take a decision NOW.' And just like that, I decided to go back to planet Earth and into my own body. A flash of light rush towards me into the space. The light was flying fast through the cosmos, starts, trees and so forth. I started descending into my body as I saw my body, the nurses, doctors in the room. My body was covered with ice and in a sort of metallic container. I started to move, and doctors rushed over to help me. I remember that it was very painful to be inside my body again. I find out after a while, that I was clinically death from cardiac and respiratory failure caused by an extremely high body temperature. I was dead for around 15-20 minutes. I was in a military hospital in Colombia, where the doctors were very young and still learning. There was a lot of confusion about the situation. After waking up, my life changed forever. I started living my life with more gratitude and purpose. Every day is a new beginning for me, full of opportunities to fulfill my dreams. I have created a deep purpose in life and started to influence other peoples' lives. I learned how to heal myself and others. I learned how to do have out of body experiences and travel the universe. I learned how to read Akashic Records for others. And I fulfilled my dream of having 4 Kids. At present time (Dec 17, 2024), I am certain that beings in other dimensions are coming to our planet to assist us and I am part of that process/plan. I am not afraid of anything. I have accomplished some amazing things in life, and am a believer that we all are Gods, creating our Universe through our Intentions. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: May 17 1990 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related While under general anesthesia. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I felt connected to everything through Energy. We were one entity, one body, one intention, and one being. Think that the Universe, if all is connected and all decisions would influence the outcome of your existance, this creates multiple scenarios, depending on your choices At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was telepathically communicating with the supreme being/energy Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. The feeling of freedom and peace was overwhelming, the sense of being a thought and travelling at the speed of light to all parts of the universe really was fascinating to me. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The experience enables to live a life with so much purpose and dedication to serve others. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My senses are tuned with the universe. I are part of all sounds, colors and shapes out there Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes I felt pulled to a tunnel made of pure light. I was inside of a beautiful, white space with like clouds on the background. I started feeling the presence of a powerful being. I did not see or hear it. I just knew that I was in the presence of pure love, comprehension, and empathy towards me. It felt like when your mom hugs you unconditionally. It was pure joy, pure love, and pure understanding. There was no judgment towards me. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was very bright white light; like being inside of clouds, but I could still can see beyond the clouds. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was floating in pure Love. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Pure Love, Pure Gratitude and Non-judgment Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. I was able to understand how the Universe works. I could understand the complexity and simplicity of how everything is connected. I understood the laws of physics, and how I was part of that network of energy. The feeling of freedom and peace was overwhelming. The sense of being a thought and travelling at the speed of light to all parts of the universe was fascinating to me. Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. All my past events unfold for your review, like images inside of my brain or when I am dreaming Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I started to think on what my legacy on earth would be if I never return to earth. I remember that I wanted to finish my studies, that I wanted to have a family with four kids. My deepest desire was to assist others on planet Earth, and that my mission was not finish yet. Then, God said, 'Then, it looks like you need to return. It is your decision to either stay here, go back in your body or go back in different body. But you have to take a decision NOW.' And just like that, I decided to go back to planet Earth and into my own body. Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I started to think on what my legacy on earth would be if I never return to earth. I remember that I wanted to finish my studies, that I wanted to have a family with four kids. My deepest desire was to assist others on planet Earth, and that my mission was not finish yet. Then, God said, 'Then, it looks like you need to return. It is your decision to either stay here, go back in your body or go back in different body. But you have to take a decision NOW.' And just like that, I decided to go back to planet Earth and into my own body. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Not following Catholic Church anymore. Decided to learn about other religions What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated Realized after my experience that Religion is a way to control humanity and to set fear into the population. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Since I was Catholic, I believed in Jesus and follow his teaching. However, I always questioned the doctrine of teaching unfair facts to the believers Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Have a deep sense of purpose and help animals, nature and people every day Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Create a life full of purpose. During the experience, I was fully aware that I did not leave a Legacy after leaving my body on planet Earth. It felt that I as wasting my energy and time without fulfilling my purpose During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I was able to understand how the Universe works, Understood the complexity and simplicity of how everything is connected; and how I was part of that network of energy. The feeling of freedom and peace was overwhelming, the sense of being a thought and travel at the speed of light to all parts of the universe was fascinating to me. God made me aware of the concept of Oneness During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes God is fully aware of our existence and seems that he is fully aware of our purpose in life. Or maybe it is our higher conscience, which is more connected with God in a regular basis. We all are creating our life, through our daily decisions. We are creators every second with our Intentions and emotions Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes Since I was a Kid, I have always had the sense that I came to planet earth to be part of a truly transformation event. I know I will be part of the plan to connect to other beings in other planets and dimensions. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes Living a life with a purpose (legacy) and helping others. That's it During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes After waking up, my life changed forever. I started living my life with more gratitude and purpose. Every day is a new beginning for me, full of opportunities to fulfill my dreams. I have created a deep purpose in life and started to influence other peoples' lives. I learned how to heal myself and others. I learned how to do have out of body experiences and travel the universe. I learned how to read Akashic Records for others. And I fulfilled my dream of having 4 Kids. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes WE all can do anything through love. Love and Gratitude are very powerful tools for our souls What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I know have a clear understanding of what Religion is versus Spirituality. I considered myself a Spiritual Being having an earthy experience Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes My relationships are more spiritual and fuller of purpose. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. This event is so vivid in my memory. It feels like it was yesterday that happens Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Huge Intuition. Can Create my own reality through my desires, thoughts and emotions Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? We all are Gods.....We can change the world together towards creating a universal consciousness Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes About 10 Years. Not sure how others will take it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real It is the most realistic of all my experiences so far What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It is the most realistic of all my experiences so far At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Have deep connections with Metatron and have experience the cube of Creation; full of colors and shapes Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? WE are creating a special world today. Soon, we are going to hear about other beings visiting us. We have to be prepared and ready to evolve. I would love to see Jesus and have a conversation with him Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Great all questions. Thanks. iyde872_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: Presence of a powerful being/supreme energy that was not seen or heard; experienced as “pure love, comprehension, and empathy.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “Beautiful, white space with like clouds on the background.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He concluded his “mission was not finish yet” and chose to return to assist others on Earth.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Simultaneous travel/being in multiple places at once; understanding laws of physics/universal connection.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with multi-location travel and cosmic understanding preceded the tunnel and encounter with the loving presence; then life review/dialogue, decision point, and return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He reported traveling to “several places simultaneously” and being in “multiple times - at the same time.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Choice presented to “stay here, go back in your body or go back in different body.” Post-NDE claims include learning to heal self/others, having OBEs, traveling the universe, reading Akashic Records, and later “deep connections with Metatron” and “the cube of Creation.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating in the room.” “I rapidly found out that I was pure energy as I started traveling to several places simultaneously.” “I felt pulled to a tunnel made of pure light.” “It felt like when your mom hugs you unconditionally.” “There was no judgment towards me.” “Then, it looks like you need to return… But you have to take a decision NOW.” “It was very painful to be inside my body again.” “We all are Gods, creating our Universe through our Intentions.”
